title: Texas and Mexican influence on New Orleans jazz
summary: He argues the western influence came up from Mexico through Texas to New Orleans and claims Texas jazz is underrated. Crawford notes Texas jazz towns, and Parker recalls playing a summer in New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels
